notes: tdd_guard_enabled       → tdd-guard.sh exits 0 when false (RED-before-prod rule off).
main_push_block_enabled → git-guard.sh stops denying 'git push ... main' / 'git commit on main' when false. force-push, gh pr merge, and branch -D main remain enforced.
Both default to true so out-of-the-box the kit is strict. Toggle via /dev-kit-lite:setup-guard.
fail_closed semantics of the hook itself are preserved — only the rule is skipped, never the hook wiring.
